title: WeKnora Overview
body:
WeKnora is an open-source LLM knowledge platform from Tencent. It turns raw documents into a queryable RAG store, an autonomous ReAct agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki. The three modes share the same knowledge bases so everyday lookups, multi-step tasks, and long-form distillation stay in sync.

Core modes:
- RAG Quick Q&A for everyday lookups with citations
- ReAct Agent that orchestrates retrieval, tools, and sandboxes
- Wiki Mode that distills documents into interlinked markdown pages with a knowledge graph

title: RAG Quick Q&A
body:
RAG mode retrieves relevant chunks from indexed documents, optionally reranks them, and asks an LLM to answer with citations. It is the fastest path for factual questions against a knowledge base.

Typical flow: upload documents → chunk + embed → hybrid search (keyword + vector) → rerank → generate answer with source snippets. Chunk editing with revision history lets you fix retrieval units like documents.

title: ReAct Agent
body:
The ReAct Agent handles multi-step tasks. It can search knowledge, read documents, call MCP tools, use web search, and run skills in session-persistent sandboxes (Docker / E2B / Cube). Cross-session long-term memory remembers who you are and recurring questions.

Use Agent mode when a single retrieval pass is not enough — for example comparing policies across folders or drafting a summary that needs several source documents.

title: Wiki Mode
body:
Wiki Mode distills raw documents into a self-maintaining, interlinked markdown knowledge base with an interactive knowledge graph. Pages support manual editing, revision history, and one-click rollback.

Entities and topics become pages. Related pages link together. The graph view shows how concepts connect across the corpus.

title: Deployment Options
body:
WeKnora can be deployed several ways:
- Docker Compose (standard): ParadeDB PostgreSQL, Redis, app, docreader, frontend
- Kubernetes Helm chart for clusters
- Lite single binary with SQLite for personal / low-resource use
- Desktop app (Lite + GUI) still maturing

Recommended Compose starter: clone the repo, copy .env.example to .env, set DB credentials, REDIS_PASSWORD, JWT_SECRET, and SYSTEM_AES_KEY, then docker compose pull && docker compose up -d. Open http://localhost and complete onboarding.

title: FAQ
body:
Q: Does WeKnora need an external LLM?
A: Yes for generation. Configure OpenAI-compatible APIs, DeepSeek, Qwen, Ollama, or other built-in vendors during onboarding.

Q: Where is data stored?
A: In self-hosted mode, documents and vectors stay in your environment (Postgres/ParadeDB by default, or other configured backends).

Q: What file types are supported?
A: PDF, Word, images, Excel, XMind and more, with multi-source sync from Feishu, Notion, GitLab, Confluence, RSS, and others.
